$comment: Mirror of sprk_analysisaction.sprk_inputschema for compose-compare-to-playbook (spaarkeai-compose-r2 task 041, FR-08). Normalized OpenAI-function-parameters subset. Consumes the R1 compose-selection JPS scope; selectionText is the load-bearing LLM input, matter/firm playbook entries are supplied by the retrieval layer (not a maker-provided input field). Property-level "required": true is FORBIDDEN. No actionId (assigned at deploy, task 047). actionCode carries NO version suffix.

selectionText.description: The selected contract clause to compare against the matter/firm playbook. The clause the attorney highlighted in the Compose editor.
selectionText.elicitation_prompt: Which clause should I compare to the playbook? Select it in the document first.
selectionText.ledger_resolution: compose.selectionText — the current editor selection dispatched by the FR-14 inline AI toolbar (compose-selection scope). Matter/firm playbook entries are supplied by the retrieval layer at dispatch time.
